remarks: Step into over 6000 sqft of sophisticated living space across 4 finished levels in this stunning colonial home. As you enter, natural light floods the main living area through French doors, highlighting the open and inviting layout. The chef's kitchen is a centerpiece, featuring white Caesarstone counters, an 8-burner gas cook-top, Thermador stainless steel appliances, a wine fridge, and a wet bar, perfect for hosting gatherings. Imagine summer entertaining on the blue stone patio, overlooking a half-acre of land with ample space for a pool, surrounded by nature. The Primary Suite offers a luxurious retreat with vaulted ceilings, oversized windows, a spacious walk-in closet, a freestanding soaking tub, and a porcelain Kolkata tiled shower. Three additional bedrooms, each with en-suite baths, ensure comfort and privacy for all. The fully finished basement expands your living space with a full bath, theater room, playroom, and guest room, while the walk-up finished attic provides versatile bonus areas to suit your needs. Located on a tranquil cul-de-sac, Eno Lane is just a short walk from the Metro-North train line, making commutes to NYC a breeze. The home is conveniently close to I-95 and some of Fairfield County's finest dining options. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the quick access to the Saugatuck River for boating on the Long Island Sound and the proximity to hundreds of acres of land trust for hiking and exploring.
